cases.name: etaf-tanks-embedded-focus-exit-pauses-and-preserves-battle
cases.purpose: Leaving an embedded game pauses the real Godot battle; reentry preserves the battlefield, while help, settings and host exits consume one Escape each.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-embedded-publication-keeps-host-focus
cases.purpose: An asynchronous backend screen publication preserves focus already moved to the enclosing host.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-help-keeps-focus-during-screen-publication
cases.purpose: An asynchronous backend screen change leaves the help focus and opening snapshot intact without a rejected background focus operation.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-help-entries-pause-and-preserve-the-battle
cases.purpose: Question mark, F1 and the help button open the same in-buffer modal, pause the real battlefield, block background keys and preserve paused state and focus after layered Escape.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-maps-are-validated-before-play
cases.purpose: Previews report map defects and an invalid or undersized map cannot start a battle.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-settings-and-difficulty-are-validated
cases.purpose: Out-of-range settings are rejected and difficulty sets the starting lives.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-losing-the-base-ends-the-battle
cases.purpose: A shell reaching the eagle base loses the battle.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-armored-enemies-take-four-hits
cases.purpose: An armored tank loses one armor per hit and is tallied only when destroyed.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-world-runs-without-input-and-pauses-atomically
cases.purpose: Enemies advance on the native clock without commands and freeze while paused.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-snapshots-restore-paused-with-atomic-rejection
cases.purpose: Snapshots restore the battle paused while malformed or missing files preserve it.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-battles-are-independent
cases.purpose: One running instance cannot advance a second paused battlefield.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-keys-drive-aim-fire-and-pause-a-campaign
cases.purpose: The game metadata and visible title identify 坦克大战; the stage select starts a campaign that documented keys drive, aim, fire, pause and leave.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-editor-shift-arrow-draws-a-stroke
cases.purpose: Holding Shift with an arrow key paints every step of the move while a plain arrow only moves, so one held key draws a stroke in the editor.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-editor-paints-saves-and-test-plays
cases.purpose: The editor exposes key guidance, button and keyboard painting, undo and continuous-mode state, then saves a custom map used by test play and the catalog.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-themes-and-resize-preserve-paused-battle
cases.purpose: Appearance and resizing preserve the battlefield, state and keyboard focus.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-text-scale-preserves-paused-battle-and-image-rows
cases.purpose: Zoom repartitions native strips to the effective row height while retaining the paused battle, image content and focus.

cases.name: etaf-tanks-appearance-follows-the-host
cases.purpose: Switching the appearance a host provides repaints the battle surface in the new palette.
